import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Fix species label variants
    species_mapping = {'Adeile': 'Adelie', 'Gentto': 'Gentoo', 'Chinstarp': 'Chinstrap'}
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace(species_mapping)
    
    # Fix island label variants (trim whitespace)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to numeric (remove commas and convert)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    # Fix negative flipper_length_mm (assume absolute value is intended)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    df_clean = clean(df)
    counts = df_clean['island'].value_counts().to_dict()
    return counts
